use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use MATRIX = List[List[int]]

kronecker(left: MATRIX, right: MATRIX) -> MATRIX =>
    (0..left.count * right.count)
        |> map(row =>
            (0..left[0].count * right[0].count)
                |> map(column =>
                    left[row / right.count][column / right[0].count] *
                    right[row % right.count][column % right[0].count])
                |> collect_list())
        |> collect_list()

power(seed: MATRIX, order: int) -> MATRIX =>
    (let result mut = seed

     for _ in 1..order do
         result = kronecker(result, seed)
     od

     result)

plot(cells: MATRIX, path: string) is
    let scale = 4

    let image =
        IMAGE(cells[0].count * scale, cells.count * scale)

    for row in 0..cells.count do
        for column in 0..cells[row].count do
            if cells[row][column] == 0 then
                continue
            fi

            for down in 0..scale do
                for across in 0..scale do
                    image.set_pixel(
                        column * scale + across, row * scale + down,
                        40ub, 40ub, 160ub
                    )
                od
            od
        od
    od

    image.write(path)

    image.show(path)
si

let vicsek = [[0, 1, 0], [1, 1, 1], [0, 1, 0]]
let saltire = [[1, 0, 1], [0, 1, 0], [1, 0, 1]]

plot(power(vicsek, 4), "vicsek.png")
plot(power(saltire, 4), "saltire.png")
